entities.name: BslA
observations: Bacillus anthracis BslA(260–652) binds mammalian laminin; 2016 study reported SPR KD 3.172×10^-9 M and supported binding with overlay, far-Western, and ELISA assays.

entities.name: Laminin
observations: Identified as a mammalian extracellular-matrix ligand for Bacillus anthracis BslA in PMID:27514510.

entities.name: PMID:27514510
observations: 2016 BMC Microbiology study titled “Bacillus anthracis S-layer protein BslA binds to extracellular matrix by interacting with laminin”; biochemical assays identified laminin as a BslA ligand.
